questionSnapshot.question: In Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937), which object tells the Queen who is fairest of all?

notes: Replaced broad consult with the specific inquiry and removed magical/magic echo. Four parallel objects; easy. No other Snow White digest question asks the answering mirror identity.
